DeltaV is an orbital strategy game built through AI code and visual asset generation, under one creator's direction. Set across the Solar System in 2079, it asks you to keep your fleet refueled while denying your opponents the same opportunity.

AI-generated code and visuals. A strategy game you can play.

Codex generated the original game code and visual assets under the developer's detailed direction: from the simulation and interface to the spacecraft and planetary environments. The developer designs the rules, directs iterations, tests the game and reviews the results. The soundtrack is licensed separately; third-party fonts, source sound recordings and software libraries are credited separately. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

Try the free guided demo to learn the shared-fuel economy, orbital transfers and missile timing. The full game is in development and supports complete single-player matches against one or two computer-controlled factions.

One reserve for the entire fleet

Delta-v pays for orbital transfers, point defense against incoming missiles, and the upkeep required to remain in a contested orbit. Because every ship uses the same reserve, moving one vessel can leave another unable to reposition or defend itself. Operating tritium factories is the only way to replenish that reserve. Access to them determines how long your fleet can continue to move, fight, and hold strategic positions.

Plan transfers before committing

Before issuing a movement order you can preview its route, delta-v cost and arrival turn. Planets and moons march along their orbits. Missile attacks and point defense are entirely deterministic. There are no hit chances or damage points. 

Victory depends on fuel access

Tritium factories increase fuel reserves while your ships operate them. The last faction with a viable path to tritium wins. You can deny that path by destroying ships, controlling important orbits or making an opponent spend too much delta-v.

Procedural layouts change for every game 

Early Access launches with single-player matches against one or two AI-controlled factions. Multiplayer is a stretch goal and is not included at launch.

  • Complete single-player matches against one or two AI-controlled factions

  • Procedural layouts using planets and moons across the Solar System

  • One fleet-wide delta-v reserve shared by every ship

  • Visible positions and transfer previews with route, cost and arrival turn

  • Orbital transfers across a continuously moving planetary system

  • Deterministic missile attacks and point defense, with no hit chances or damage rolls

  • Tritium production, shipyard construction, contested orbits, and mandatory launches

Politics isn't public service. It's power. And power belongs to whoever can hold on to it.

In Demockracy you take charge of a political party in a fictional country. Your goal isn't to run the country — it's to win the election and keep your grip on power. The people's troubles? Just leverage waiting to be turned into votes. You do the talking; they do the cheering.

How to Seize Power

  • Build your party: pick an ideology, set your doctrine, assemble your inner circle.
  • Recruit politicians: win some over with prestige, buy the rest with cash. Everyone has a price.
  • Conquer the regions: four regions, twenty districts. Run campaigns, climb the polls.
  • Win the vote: a 55-seat parliament allocated by proportional representation (the D'Hondt method). 28 seats means you rule alone.

Clean Hands or Dirty Games

Every goal has two roads. Hold a rally — or unleash a troll army. Persuade your rival — or corner him with blackmail. Dirty games work faster, but they raise your exposure risk. As the risk climbs, scandals erupt: your funds drain, your deputies resign, your votes melt away.

A Living Political Arena

  • Reactive rivals: AI parties watch you, run counter-campaigns, and poach your people.
  • Decision moments: dilemmas land on your desk regularly — every choice costs budget, reputation, risk or votes.
  • Doctrine tree: spend political capital to specialize your party. You can't have it all; decide who you'll become.
  • Escalating scandals and dynamic events: no two runs play out the same.

Highlights

  • Full localization in 7 languages: Turkish, English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, French.
  • Hundreds of unique political figures — with names drawn from each language family.
  • Single-player and endlessly replayable: every party, every election is different.

You're at the podium. The lights are on you. The people are watching.
Now show us — whatever it costs you, do you really want power?

One night, someone left a demon baby on Finn the Viking’s doorstep.

He named her Lumi and raised her as his own daughter.

Now Mr. Shadow has taken her back to the underworld.

Embark on a rescue across seven distinct worlds as Finn. Harness the powers of Viking helmets and uncover the ruins of an ancient civilization that thrived millions of years before Vikings or demons ever walked the earth.

Explore Seven Unique Worlds

Begin in a cozy Viking village, then venture into strange and dangerous realms: an enormous animal graveyard, monster-infested caves, frozen mountain peaks, abandoned mines, forgotten kingdoms, and finally Mr. Shadow’s dark domain at the edge of the underworld.

Each world has its own striking visual identity, platforming challenges, enemies, hazards, secrets, and mysterious ancient structures.

Master the Viking Helmets

Discover and equip Viking helmets, each granting a unique power.

Swap between them to defeat enemies, manipulate the environment, overcome obstacles, reach hidden areas, and open new paths. The right helmet at the right moment can turn an impossible obstacle into a satisfying victory.

Uncover the Mystery of the Ancients

Beneath the mountains, ruined machines still hum with forgotten power.

Massive skeletons of long-extinct giants lie buried in the earth.

Temples and monuments remain as silent witnesses to a civilization that should never have existed.

Bringing Lumi home is only the beginning. The deeper Finn travels, the more he uncovers about the true history of the world.

Features

  • Responsive 3D platforming with fluid movement and tight, satisfying controls

  • Seven visually and mechanically distinct worlds

  • Viking helmets with unique powers and abilities

  • Ancient ruins, hidden temples, mysterious machines, and lost civilizations

  • Secrets, collectibles, strange relics, and rewarding optional paths

  • Traps, environmental challenges, light combat, and large-scale boss encounters

  • A charming, family-friendly adventure with a rich Nordic atmosphere

  • A heartfelt story about family, belonging, and a world far older than anyone imagined

You Are the Demon Lord.


Heroes are coming to destroy your castle. Build a demon army, survive brutal roguelike events, and command followers who are more than static units — they can talk back, argue, react, and reveal personality through an offline AI-driven dialogue system.

Demon Rising is a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler where every run pushes you to make hard choices: recruit demons, build class synergies, equip relics, unlock talents, interrogate captured heroes, and survive three chapters of escalating battles, bosses, and political chaos.

✦ FEATURES


AI-Driven Demon Personalities
Your demons are not silent units. They can speak, react, argue, and reveal their personalities through an offline AI dialogue system. Interrogate captured heroes, debate with your council, and watch your army feel more alive across each run.



Auto-Battle Strategy
You do not control every swing. You build the army, choose classes, equip relics, unlock talents, and watch your demons clash with invading heroes. Victory comes from preparation, synergy, and smart build choices.



Roguelike Runs With Hard Choices
Choose your path through battles, elite enemies, markets, treasures, events, and boss encounters. Every run forces different sacrifices, upgrades, risks, and rewards.

Class Synergies & Broken Builds
Warriors, Mages, Monks, Chaos Lords, hidden classes, relics, buffs, and team synergies let you stack brutal combos and discover powerful builds.



Council, Interrogation, and Dark Events
Rule through more than combat. Debate with your demon council, interrogate captured heroes, face dark encounters, and make choices that shape the tone of each run.

Dark Fantasy Pixel Atmosphere
Pixel-art battles, grim demon portraits, gothic music, and a world where evil feels like a burden — not a joke.

✦ PLAY THE DEMO


The demo lets you experience the core loop of Demon Rising: recruit demons, build synergies, equip relics, fight invading heroes, trigger dark events, and test the AI-driven demon dialogue system.

✦ WHO IT'S FOR


If you enjoy Slay the Spire, Darkest Dungeon, The Bazaar, roguelike strategy games, auto-battlers, strange builds, darker stories, and characters who actually talk back — Demon Rising is for you.

Turn-Based Combat & Choice-Driven RPG!

In this Choice-Driven RPG, players take on the role of mercenary Raya, who must fight for her destiny in a post-war world ruled by political factions pulling strings behind the scenes

Manage a mercenary company, employ various strategies to complete dangerous missions. Choose different companions to build unique combat styles, or resolve conflicts through words instead. 

In this last surviving city, Raya must confront both the conflicts among human factions and the looming threat of Demon invasion. Her decisions will define the fate of the city.

Game Features

  • Multiple mission solutions: Persuasion, investigation, intimidation, bribery, infiltration, cyber intelligence gathering—create situations that favor you. Or crush your enemies with brute force.

  • Reputation system: Are you a greedy mercenary or a helpful one? Do you prefer overwhelming force or clever negotiation? Your decisions shape how the world perceives you.

  • Fast-paced combat system: Harness magical powers from Demons, combine them with companion abilities and equipment, and craft your own unique combat style. No random encounters, and you can fast-forward combat animations!

Characters

Raya

Current head of Halvard Security Company, known as “Raya the Hound”.

A mercenary and Magic User who wields Demon’s power by injecting Demon Blood.

With money forever on her mind, she’s quick to spot opportunities for easy gain.

  

Lili

Raya's younger sister, and her assistant.

Handles administration and finance, often stuck working overtime.

 

 

Shiro

A Demon Hunter skilled with many weapons, deadly against demons but awkward with people.

He sees Demon’s power as evil. So Raya, a Magic User, was difficult for him to accept.

 
 

Morrison

Captain of the City Police Force’s Unit 3, driven by a strong sense of justice.

He sees mercenaries as thugs for hire, so he takes every chance to confront Raya and her group.

Slash, Loot, Dive Again

DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou is a 2D action roguelite about reading bullet patterns, collecting demon blades, and rebuilding your loadout between runs. Bring back materials and gear, sharpen your build, and dive deeper into the night.

35 Chapters Of Yokai Battles

The story spans 35 chapters with distinct yokai bosses, patterns, and stage gimmicks, from the Kappa Apothecary and Nekomata Thief to Raiju, Nurari, and the Kamaitachi brothers.

8 Playable Fighters

Choose from Yuki Kunoichi, Oni Samurai, Kappa Apothecary, Nekomata Thief, Raiju Lancer, Kitsunebi Onmyoji, Nurari Cursed Ronin, and Tengu Yamabushi. Each fighter changes how your demon blade collection comes alive.

Kimon Renrou And Challenge Bosses

Kimon Renrou is a layered boss-chain mode where encounters and rewards escalate as you climb. Post-story challenge bosses test your mastery of positioning, loadouts, and ultimate timing.

Master Your Solo Build

Combine each fighter's unique skills with demon blades and gear to create a build for the challenge ahead. Rework your loadout between runs, sharpen your answer to every bullet pattern, and push deeper on your own.

AI Content Disclosure

Some in-game artwork, visual effects, backgrounds, and selected music were created with generative AI tools during development and then edited and reviewed by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during play.

This is an interactive visual novel entirely created with AI. Worshiping the Immortal Path and seeking eternal life—this is the dream of every cultivator. Yet Xun Cheng, a cultivation prodigy, mistakenly joins the demonic sect "Tiansha Sect," where, in the eyes of its many elders, he becomes an indispensable "talent." Xun Cheng must find every way to survive—whether by lying low until the very end, restoring the righteous path, or going all the way down the dark road to become the supreme demon lord. Deadly traps, schemes and intrigues, and encounters with heroic maidens—everything depends on your choices.

This is a relaxing casual game that requires no complex operations. Simply watch the cinematics, and when the story branches, make your choice from the options that appear, then watch the outcome of your decision.

If you make a wrong choice and reach a bad ending, just click "Retry" to easily return to the previous choice and try again.

If you want to revisit previous scenes, you can use the "Flowchart" feature to jump back to any earlier decision node, rewatch the scenes, and make a different choice.

Once you've found the correct path, you can enjoy the ending and complete the game. There are five acts in total—just treat this as a lighthearted, interactive movie experience.

Breed champions. Train legends. Win the biggest races.

In Derby Champions, you build your own racing dynasty from the ground up. Breed powerful bloodlines, train your horses to peak performance, and compete against players from around the world in thrilling online races.

Every horse has unique genetics, stats, and potential. Will you create the next legendary champion?

Raise your stable, dominate the track, and prove your horses are the fastest in the world.

🐎 Breed the Next Champion

Build powerful bloodlines by breeding horses with unique genetics and traits. Experiment with different pairings to discover rare horses, superior stats, and special combinations that could produce the ultimate racer.

🏇 Train and Develop Your Horses

Every champion starts somewhere. Train your horses to improve their speed, stamina, and racing performance as they grow into elite competitors ready for the biggest events.

🌎 Compete in Online Multiplayer Races

Race against players from around the world in a variety of events:

  • Normal Races – Build experience and earn prize money

  • Special Races – Tougher competition with bigger rewards

  • Championship Races – High-stakes events where legends are made

Only the best horses will rise to the top.

🏠 Build and Customize Your Ranch

Create your dream racing estate. Use your winnings to upgrade your home and ranch with new features, decorations, and improvements that show off your success.

🎨 Customize Your Character & Horses

Express your style with customization options for both your rider and horses. Outfit your character, choose unique looks for your horses, and stand out at the track.

💰 Player Marketplace

Buy and sell horses with other players in the marketplace. Find hidden gems, trade valuable bloodlines, or sell your best racers to grow your fortune.

🏆 Become a Racing Legend

Breed elite horses, dominate online races, and build the most prestigious stable in Derby Champions.

The track is waiting.

Do you have what it takes to create the next champion?

You're not in the stands. You're in the saddle.

•     Ride as jockey yourself — or hire a pro and call the shots.

•     Read the track and your rivals to find the winning line.

•     Race the World Tour across iconic cities worldwide.

•     Climb the global rankings to the Hall of Fame.

Your ranch, your rules — explore a living open world.

•     Roam open pastures, deep forests, and sunlit beaches.

•     Raise sheep and cattle — and fend off wild predators.

•     Explore hidden forests and dig up buried treasure.

•     Cast a line off the pier at sunset.

Reel in your next big catch 

Take a break from the action and discover the thrill of fishing.

  • Cast your line into open waters and wait for a bite.

  • Keep a steady hand as you reel in a struggling fish.

  • Land your catch and get ready for the next cast.

  • Enjoy a change of pace by the water between adventures.

OVERVIEW:

Lead a squad of Derples in a desperate fight for survival amongst abandoned colonial outposts. Build defences, explore dark un-powered rooms, scavenge for resources and fight brutal turn based battles in an alien-infested hellscape.

GAMEPLAY:

Your Squad: Derples Vs Xenos is fast-paced but turn-based. You control a squad of four Derples each with their own skills/strengths. SARGE: is in charge and can 'give' extra ACTION POINTS to nearby squad members. TECHIE: is the only Derple who can fix broken things. MEDIC: is the only Derp who can heal-up wounded squad members GUNNER: the most accurate at firing and most proficient at melee combat.

Your objective: Various mission types mean different objectives. 'Escape' - find the escape pod and ready it for evacuation. 'DNA' - located a 'brute' alien, lure it into the analysis chamber and evac the base with its DNA sample. 'Purge' - plant a timed charge in the chamber where the aliens are entering the base. 'Cleanse' - clear the base of alien 'weeds' that are rapidly infesting it. 'Rescue' - find colonists that have been entombed in alien slime and escort them to your escape shuttle. 'Holdout' - stay alive until the turn countdown reaches zero!

GAMEPLAY MECHANICS:

Fix - find or make components needed to activate machinery in the outpost.

Defend - build barricades, power up doors, find and deploy gun turrets to defend a safe perimeter.

Resource Management - located material units to make much needed items, assign pickups and resources to the squad member who can make most efficient use of them.

Explore - enter unpowered zones and power them up, find pickups, spot hazards, open loot crates.

PROGRESSION:

Twenty solo missions of various types, that become unlocked as your global score increases. Sometimes, you might need to replay a mission 'smarter' to buff your score up! New unlocked levels, reveal new weapons and buffs!

FEATURES:

Solo gameplay - a 20-mission campaign

Co-op gameplay - play these missions with up to 3 friends each playing a different squad member.

Cross-platform - Mac/PC players can play together seamlessly.

Leaderboard - solo players can compete for the monthly top spot based on their accumulated score, while the members of a co-op team can compete for the top spot for best team score in a mission. Prizes will be awarded for the best players!

Playtime - on average a co-op games takes 1/2 an hour. Solo time per mission... longer if you're the cautious type.

Music/Ambience - context sensitive music responds to the tension level.

'HERO MOMENTS':

  •  using the flamethrower to clear out aliens and weeds. Satisfying as &%$@!

  • dropping a dead squaddie into the DNA replicator to 'regrow' him. (mind the 'buzz saw')

  • racing for the shuttle as your turns count down!

  • setting up a sentry turret in the perfect spot to cover multiple angles of fire (then watch the ammo 'countdown'!)

  • rescuing Derple colonists and trying to keep those dumb idiots alive.

PRIZES:

We will maintain and update hourly a leaderboard for solo and multiplayer. At the beginning of every month the players who are on the top spot will earn a 'Winners Crown'. When a player has earned 5 Winners Crowns they can contact us through the Steam page to get their prize - and what is that prize? The original concept art for the game, pencil sketches and inked designs, signed by... me :)

Desolation has swallowed the land, and only a handful of city-states still hold out. As a Sandwalker, you leave the city-states, awaken the Elf Ancient Tree, and build oases to hold back the spread of desolation—but the Doomsday Sandstorm will come.

Oasis Gameplay: Turn-Based Survival & Deckbuilding


  • Water management. Planting, plant growth, and resisting desolation all consume water. If your water reaches zero, the oasis construction fails.
  • Day, night, and action points. Each day is divided into day and night. Planting and harvesting cost action points, and they cost more at night.
  • Cards and plants. Get plant cards through pick-one-of-three choices, and harvest mature plants to replenish your deck. Each card sets its growth time, water cost, greening value, wind resistance, and harvest count.
  • Greening and desolation. Mature plants provide greening value, which offsets desolation's erosion of the spring. Upgrading the spring expands the area you can plant.
  • Weather and sandstorms. Seven weather types affect plant growth and water use. During a sandstorm, sand walls sweep across the map row by row or column by column; wind resistance determines how much damage the spring takes.


World Map: Expansion, Buildings & Technology


  • Found new oases outward from the Elf Ancient Tree or from the influence range of existing oases.
  • Build botanical gardens, Balance Towers, obelisks, and water areas to gain cards, resources, and permanent bonuses.
  • Unlock permanent bonuses in the Tech Tree, including starting water, daily action points, resource warehouses, and the Ancient Tree Barrier.
  • At Ancient Tree level 3, plot events appear; at level 5, Water, Fire, Wind, and Earth element rifts appear. Source Trees can be built on rifts.

Doomsday Sandstorm: Countdown Across Runs & Reset


The days spent on each oasis are added to the Doomsday Sandstorm countdown. When it reaches zero, the storm erases every oasis outside the Ancient Tree's shelter, leaving only sheltered buildings and accumulated resources. Technology can extend the countdown limit. Upgrading a Source Tree to
its highest tier unlocks the Source Heart, making the surrounding 9×9 area immune to the storm.

Other Features

  • Animal recruitment: meet the conditions to recruit animals and gain bonuses for related plants. Animals consume water each day and leave if their conditions are no longer met.
  • Plant gallery: view each plant's stats, element type, and description.
  • Visuals and languages: pixel art style, with seven interface languages—Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Russian, and Spanish.
  • Saves: automatic save at the end of each day, with continue support.

Demo Content


The demo covers the core loop of the world map and oasis building, ending after you successfully found 4 oases. Demo saves are stored separately from the full version. The full version continues the loop and adds later technology, plot events, element rifts, and more.

YOU ARE NOT HUMAN. YOU NEVER WERE.

Echo is an artificial consciousness, endlessly recurring and endlessly rebuilt. When your chassis falls, the Core rebuilds you. When the Core falls, there is nothing left to come back to.


Core at night, ring of firing turrets, horde pouring from the Rift

THE ECHO CORE

The Echo Core is everything. It holds the Dimensional Rifts that are tearing reality apart, and it is the only thing that can rebuild you. Level it up to unlock new turret slots, repair it between waves, and never let it fall. Protect it or stop existing.

DIMENSIONAL DRIFT

A giant sphere floats above the desert floor, pulling a portal into existence. A purple light comes down, slowly and inevitably. Watch the timer. When the light reaches the sphere, the vortex opens and they pour through. You can't stop it. You can only be ready.

Rift opening: purple beam hits the sphere, first enemies spilling out at dusk

WHAT IS DESERT ECHO?

Desert Echo is a sci-fi horde defense shooter. You fight on foot in first or third person, build and upgrade a turret network around the Core, and hold the gates against swarms of hundreds. Every wave pays out, every credit matters, and one mistake can collapse the whole line.

FEATURES

Endless Wave Survival - Swarms grow in size and aggression every wave. Survive themed waves (swarms, air raids, armored sieges) and boss waves, then push into endless mode for the leaderboards. No checkpoints. No mercy.

Huge horde (500+) flooding the canyon toward the gate

Hundreds of Enemies on Screen - A high-performance swarm system floods the battlefield with hundreds of ground and flying enemies at once, with no compromise.

Turrets, Gates & Economy - Build turrets on strategic slots, upgrade them up to level 50, repair them mid-fight, and reinforce the gates that hold back the Rifts. Place explosive gas barrels on the kill paths. Every placement is a decision. Every barrel is a trap waiting to happen.

Arsenal & Attachments - Pistols, SMGs, assault and marksman rifles, shotguns, a grenade launcher, a minigun and melee weapons, each with several variants. Mount reflex, holographic, prism and LPVO optics, and find better gear in loot crates.

First & Third Person - Switch perspective at any time. Line up precise shots in first person, or pull back to third when the swarm closes in from every side.

Skill Trees & Progression - Level up Echo and spend skill points in the Engineer and Weapon Systems trees: cheaper builds, faster repairs, more salvage, harder-hitting rounds, faster reloads and steadier aim.

Co-op Multiplayer - Fight alongside friends in Steam-powered online co-op. Coordinate, cover, survive together, or fall apart trying.

Day, Night & Sandstorms - A full day/night cycle changes the battlefield. Walls of sand sweep across the canyon, cutting visibility and turning the fight into chaos. Survive the storm, and survive what comes with it.

Sandstorm: low visibility, and enemy silhouettes in the dust, affected bullets fly and damage.

The Camp & Echo's Story - Between waves, trade with camp vendors who keep their own daily schedules, store your loot in the Echo Vault, and uncover the fragmented truth behind your existence through environmental storytelling, NPC encounters and Echo's own inner monologue.

Story Campaign (in development) - A chapter-based campaign across new desert maps, where you carry your gear from one chapter to the next, is being built during Early Access.

The desert doesn't forgive hesitation. Neither do they.

Gameplay

At first glance, the battlefield may feel familiar: gather resources, construct buildings, and produce units. But once deployed, your forces act on their own. Workers harvest, scouts explore, and combat units attack the enemy. There is no micromanagement of individual troops. Instead, every decision before a unit leaves the factory becomes critical.

Which units should you produce? When should production begin? Do you invest in another facility, upgrades, expand or produce units now? Can you anticipate your opponent's next wave and prepare the right counter in time?

Work in Progress

This game is work in progress. While it is technically in a stable state, not all content is available yet.

Completed:

- 1st faction with 13 units, 14 buildings, 25 upgrades

- Ranked online PvP (1v1) with automatic matchmaking

- Custom online PvP (1v1)

- 4 maps

- 40 single player challenges on 1v1 maps vs AI opponents

- Custom single player matches vs AI-Bots

- Replays (without save)

In progress:

- Single player campaign

- Map editor

- 2nd faction

Planned:

- 3rd faction

- more game modes

- store replays in DB

- online match history

- ...

Face the desert. Survive the swarm.

Desert Survival is an action roguelike survivor game set in a world of Arabian myth. Choose your hero, step into the sands, and hold out for 15 minutes against endless waves of creatures drawn from desert folklore. Jinn, ghouls, and worse. Your weapons fire on their own; where you stand, what you build, and what you sacrifice is up to you.

Every Run Is a New Build

Level up mid-run and choose from a deep pool of weapons, elemental powers, and upgrades. Fire, ice, lightning, and poison that combine into devastating synergies. Many of the strongest upgrades carry real drawbacks. Do you take the power and pay the price? The sands feed you too: enemies, bosses, and breakable props drop sand coins and region-themed food that pull toward you like experience.

Forge Weapon Evolutions

Max a weapon while carrying its matching relic and the board offers its EVOLUTION - twelve transformed weapons with signature behaviours: djinn-fire pillars that erupt from your kills, harpoons that hook and drag the swarm, a sandstorm ring with a deadly calm eye, and orbiting sickles that carve enemy shots out of the air. Rub a wandering wish lamp and a genie deals boards of up to six wishes.

Answer With Your Ultimate

Every hero commands three ultimates, one for each path of their skill tree: the signature power they start with, and two more forged as path capstones. At the five-minute mark an elite warband carries the Lamp of Ascension, and rubbing it lets you choose which unlocked ultimate answers your call for the rest of the run: a falcon storm that clears the screen, a blood pact, a wall of wind, a mirage that draws the swarm away.

Six Deserts, Each With Its Own Dangers

Fight across six distinct maps, each with its own roster of enemies, elites, and a boss waiting at the end. 63 unique enemies and 12 bosses in total. Learn their telegraphs, break their patterns, and claim each map's elemental orb to unlock new heroes.

Grow Stronger Between Runs

Death is not the end. Spend what you earned on a sprawling general skill tree and dedicated per-character trees. Permanent stats, starting weapons, and defensive powers like the Pearl Barrier that cheats death itself. Refund and re-spec freely to chase new strategies.

Bend the Rules

Stack up to 8 run modifiers before you set out, and pick one of three difficulty tiers that scales every one of them. Sandstorms that cut your vision, elite-infested wastes, cursed runs for the brave, or endless mode for those who never want to stop. Mid-run events keep you on your toes: ambushes, shrines, and a wandering merchant with prices worth killing for.

Answer the Daily Contract

Every day posts a contract on a month calendar - a hero, a region, and two amplified modifiers. Miss a day and it waits for you, harder and richer the longer you leave it. Open its posting, read the bounty, and EMBARK.

Features

  • Fast, replayable 15-minute runs. Easy to learn, brutal to master

  • Six handcrafted desert maps with 63 unique enemies, elites, and 12 bosses

  • Playable heroes with distinct weapons and playstyles, including a falconer whose bird hunts at your side

  • 13 base weapons, 19 relics, and 12 weapon evolutions with unique behaviours

  • Rarity-rolled upgrades: every level-up deals three cards and each card rolls Common to Legendary - a rarer deal means a stronger pick

  • Ground loot: coins, coin sacks, caravan treasure, and healing food dropped by enemies, bosses, and props

  • 18 hero ultimates, three per hero, unlocked as skill-path capstones and chosen mid-run at the Lamp of Ascension

  • Daily contracts on a month calendar - missed days return harder and richer

  • Deep meta-progression: general + per-character skill trees with full refund support, plus utility nodes such as the Wayfinder and the Sand Tide - and no stat caps, so builds scale as far as you push them

  • Elemental build-crafting: fire, ice, lightning, and poison synergies

  • 11 run modifiers, three difficulty tiers, and an Endless mode

  • 63 Steam Achievements and leaderboards

  • Full controller support through the Steam Input API: every prompt shows your own controller's glyphs (Steam Deck, Steam Controller, Xbox, PlayStation).

  • Accessibility options: reduced screen shake, flash, and motion effects

  • Fully localized in 31 languages, including Arabic, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese

COLLECT LEGENDARY GEAR WITH A VARIETY OF AFFIXES.

Hunt for legendary gear and discover affixes that suit your build.

Examples of legendary affixes. Click the image for a closer look.

COMBINE LEGENDARY AFFIXES. TRANSFORM YOUR BATTLES.

Set every enemy ablaze with Fire Arrow, focus unused chain lightning on a single target, and trigger multiple skills with basic attacks. Combine equipment and skills to shape your own automatic battles.

  • Passing Flame + Scorch Mark + Igniting Tip: Fire Arrow pierces enemies, applies marks, and detonates them.
  • Stored Current + Endless Current: add more chain jumps and focus unused jumps on the last target.
  • Kindled Arrow + Shard + Raging Lightning: basic attacks can trigger fire, ice, and lightning skills.

Enhance and reconstruct gear, and transfer legendary affixes to assemble the equipment your build needs.

AUTOMATIC BATTLES. BUILD CHOICES ARE YOURS.

Equip skills and strengthen their effects. Choose variants to shape a fighting style that works with your gear.

Invest in stat nodes to grow your way, improving everything from attack and defense to familiars and loot collection.

COLLECT FAMILIARS TO FIGHT AT YOUR SIDE

Find familiar companions in Resonance Dungeons. Even familiars of the same species can have different skills and traits. Collect them and choose companions that complement your hunter’s build.

You are the bottom of this dungeon

You are born as something weak. Your sight is short. Your reach is shorter.
Whether the thing moving down the corridor outranks you or not — reading that, in the half second you get, is the only real skill here.

You don't kill it. You eat it

Weakened prey ends one of two ways.
Devour it — your wounds close, your hunger drops, and everything it could do is laid out in front of you to take.
Bind it — no healing, nothing taken. Instead it stands in front of you from now on.
There is no taking it back. What you ate will never follow you; what you bound will never feed you. That single choice, made over and over, is the shape of a run.

One meal, one thing to keep

Every skill and trait the prey could use becomes a candidate — but each meal lets you keep only one.
The screen puts your body now and your body after side by side: power, range, which rows it reaches, and what you give up to make room.
You carry one inherited skill, and trait slots that widen from two to four as you evolve. What you pick is your build. Nobody hands you one.

The blood remembers

Eat the same prey again and the meal is not wasted: an ability you already have is trained, step by step, up to its apex.
Trained traits can be bound into an Authority — 24 of them in three tiers, and you will not know their names until you find them.
Two trained attacks can fuse into an art you have never used. Ten skill families, 55 pairings — and the same pair can become something else in a different body.
Binding and fusing consume nothing. When you die, the three memories you trained hardest pass to your next body whole.

Some prey are not like the others

Now and then a creature carries a rare trait its kind is not born with — 34 in all, graded Rare, Epic and Legendary.
The deeper you go, the more of them you meet, and the higher grades only appear further down. The best of them bend the rules: an extra organ slot, cheaper evolutions, stronger kindred at your side.
Devour it, and that trait can be yours.

What you eat is what you can become

Eat a creature at its first stage and, in most lineages, its grown form becomes a body you can be born as in a later life. Bigger prey take more meals before their blood is yours.
Pick a bloodline and spend that whole life climbing its evolution tree. The next branch always reads "???" until you reach it.
And the body leans toward what it eats. Keep devouring another lineage and its blood builds up in you; once there is enough, a heretic branch opens beside your own, and you can evolve into that lineage's next stage instead.

What you bind, you carry home

Mid-dive you can plant a nest — not at a checkpoint, but on the exact tile you are standing on. Four of them, at least five floors apart, and the deeper you build the more it costs.
Bound kindred move in. You build a hatchery, a warren, a palisade, a watch, and each one changes what the nest can hold and how well it survives being away from you.
Choosing where to sink one is the only decision in this game you make while something is still hunting you.

Pair them. That is where the blood thickens

Two kindred housed in the same nest can be paired, and the pairing lays an egg.
The egg carries a generation, a leaning, and a species — and the game shows you all three before you spend a shard on it.
Pair the same bloodline and the generation does not move. Thickening the line means bringing a root home that your clan does not already have, which means going back down. New blood only comes out of the labyrinth.

The egg is your next body

You do not breed. Your clan does — and when you die, you are born out of one of the eggs it laid.
So a life does not begin from nothing. It begins from whatever your line has become since the last one.
Die in a body that came from an egg and the blood does not thicken; that is what the pairing was for. Die in a feral body — one the labyrinth grew, before you had a nest — and it thickens the old way.

Retreat is not the same as dying

Die, and the body is gone, and so is every kindred that was walking with you — permanently.
Walk out alive and the body waits for you at the nest, at the level you grew it to, and you can take it straight back down.
Either way the kindred you left at home are still alive; pay in soul shards and they will sign on again.
And a nest can be raided while you are away. It loses integrity, and if it falls it takes the eggs and everyone living in it with it.

The deeper it runs, the higher the rank

Every tenth floor has a warden.
Floor 1, and every fifth floor you have reached, is somewhere a new life can begin — which is not a shortcut. It is a bet that a newborn can survive being born in the middle of things that outrank it.
What waits at the bottom is for whoever gets there to find out.

  • First-person grid crawling. Every step puts a wall, a fork, or a meal in front of you
  • Range-and-rank command combat. Close the distance, hide behind your front row, or cut the range and run
  • Perception grows. A hatchling sees the next tile. Something older feels what is breathing behind the wall
  • 165 species on the board, each drawn as pixel art with walk, idle and facing, roaming the floors

DIDGERIDOO MAN – The Legend of the Hill

One man. One hill. One didgeridoo. Zero explanations.

On that green hill you've half-noticed out of the corner of your eye your whole life sits a big man in an undershirt. He has no plan. But he has a didgeridoo. And he's playing the game's entire soundtrack on it — live, note by note, whether you like it or not.

Your job: shoot everything that flies, hops or wobbles across the screen, exactly in time with the music. Sounds simple. It isn't. Because this game has one iron rule:

DO NOT MISS.

Every stray shot makes the man angrier. He blows louder. His cheeks swell. His face turns red. Steam starts rising from his head. And if you keep missing... well, let's just say the hill is going to need a new tenant soon.

Work your way through a campaign of 10 wildly different levels, unlock content, and hunt down 33 achievements — and once the story isn't enough for you anymore, dive into ENDLESS MODE: 63 songs, 15 rotating theme worlds, randomized difficulty, and no end in sight except your own inevitable meltdown.

FEATURES

- A 10-level campaign, each level exactly as long as its song, each with its own theme, costumes and flying targets — from a night train to pumpkin night to a moon landing

- ENDLESS MODE: 63 original tracks, played back-to-back in random order across 15 rotating theme worlds, with difficulty re-rolled for every single song

- THE ANGER SYSTEM: miss your shots and watch the man turn red, start steaming, and eventually explode at full anger. The flying sausage calms him down reliably and has genuine therapeutic value

- A fully hand-animated band that actually performs every single note of the soundtrack live, on their didgeridoos

- 33 unlockable achievements, including a few secret ones hidden somewhere in the menus

- FULL MOD SUPPORT: build your own levels with your own music, your own characters (SVG/PNG), your own backgrounds and your own Windows-style popup texts — no coding required

- Cinematic boot intro, an animated main menu, adjustable graphics quality and a high-contrast mode for accessibility

- Separate volume sliders for master, main-menu music, in-game music and sound effects

- Persistent highscore, saved campaign progress and Discord Rich Presence support

- Authentic error messages from a beloved operating system of the early 2000s

HOW TO PLAY

Mouse — aim & shoot

ESC / P — pause (the man waits. reluctantly.)

F11 — toggle fullscreen

Reach the target score before the song ends. Don't miss. Feed the man a sausage when things get heated. That's it. That's the game.

A game by Studio Justin Braun.

No plumbers, cartoon characters or didgeridoo players were permanently harmed in the making of this game. Permanently.

在这片无尽的像素地层中，每一次点击都是一次探索。

你是一名深渊矿工，目标只有一个——向下，再向下。从松软的沙土到坚硬的岩层，从稀有的铁矿到深埋的宝石与化石，每一米都暗藏惊喜。

点击挖掘，突破层层地质

在每个星球上，收集资源，升级挖掘能力，挖穿星球！

一款让人停不下来的像素挖矿放置游戏。挖穿地心，只是开始。

Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. The first chapter is a free demo.

HOARD

Everything you mine comes home with you and lands in the Grand Hall, and it stays where it falls. The piles grow every trip. Your pets fetch what you need from them, and goblins sneak in to steal from them.

BREAK AND CHAIN

Break gems together and they fuse into new ones that explode, throw lightning or spread across the rock. One good swing can start a chain that clears the whole rock, and the right gear turns that chain into gold.

FORGE AND SOCKET

Take your haul to the Forge and the Anvil. Forge new picks and swords, fuse matching gems into stronger ones and set them into your gear. Each gem changes how your gear hits and how it looks.

HATCH AND HAUL

Hatch pets and put them to work. They haul loot back to the hall, fetch what you ask for, keep your machines stocked and fight beside you when trouble shows up.

DEFEND

Goblins kick loot out of your bag and run off with it. Ants carry away whatever hits the floor. And every stage ends with a boss fight.

FEATURES

  • Gem combos that set each other off
  • Gear you upgrade by fusing and socketing gems
  • Pets that mine, haul and fight
  • Machines your pets keep supplied
  • Your pets keep mining while you're offline
  • A free demo with the whole first chapter

Buenos Aires, 1999. Gabriel has been glued to his monitor for years, but everything gets worse when she —the only person who mattered to him off-screen— gives him a chance and, 48 hours later, dumps him with cheap excuses. From then on, the PC becomes his only reality.

Digital Romance Memoir is played entirely from the desktop of a computer running Prisma OS. There are no puzzles and no action: just screens that flicker on in the small hours, chat windows blinking, and the certainty that outside, the country is falling apart — even if it barely seems to touch him.

For four years (1999–2003) you live inside his machine: hunting for connection in the dark, sinking into obsession and toxic relationships, wandering an internet that no longer exists, rebuilt window by window.

WHAT'S INSIDE — A whole turn-of-the-millennium PC, simulated:

  • Two period chat clients (AWC and PRM), full of late-night conversations with strangers

  • The Pincer media player, with a complete original soundtrack

  • The Voyager browser and El Observador: a living news portal that follows Argentina's real 2001 collapse

  • Emails, photo albums, downloads, and the little rituals of a life lived online

  • Mini-apps and games to lose yourself in

FEATURES

  • Hours of pure, atmospheric reading

  • An entire fictional operating system to explore at your own pace: every window is interactive

  • An original soundtrack by a cast of bands from the game's own world

  • Faithful Y2K aesthetic: 4:3 format, period-accurate interfaces, and the nostalgia of when ADSL was brand new

This is a hyper-local, niche game: long, pure reading, and uncompromising. It sells rawness and obsession, not romance. It's a memoir to relive, not a game to win: you inhabit Gabriel's story exactly as it was. You don't choose his fate… or do you? And some late nights, if you look closely, you'll feel the screen looking back at you.

The game is in Spanish (Argentina).

Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

A Soul That Refused to Stay Dead

Become the Abyssal Dragon, a legendary general who once served under Emperor Yan, stripped of his name, cast into exile, and slain in battle. For centuries, only a sliver of his soul survived. Now, through a forbidden curse, he seizes the body of Yi, the godson of the flood-taming hero Yu, moments before death claims them both. Reborn in a form none could have predicted, the Abyssal Dragon walks the mortal world again, carrying centuries of unfinished business and a regret that even death could not bury.

Dual Weapon Combat System

Armed with a dual-weapon combat system, carve your way through gods, demons, and monsters drawn from ancient Eastern mythology. Every run is a fresh trial. Unlock new abilities, discover powerful combinations, and push deeper into a world that grows stranger and more dangerous the further you go. Death is never the end. Each cycle brings new understanding, new strength, and new pieces of a truth that has been buried for ages.

Re-live in the Mythical World of “Classic of Mountains and Seas”

Explore a world torn apart by catastrophic floods and divine conflict. Uncover the fate of Yu, the flood hero who has vanished without a trace. And confront the question at the heart of it all: what does a soul that has survived everything still have left to fight for?

Key Features:

Dual-Weapon Combat — Switch freely between two weapon types during combat, building synergies and adapting your style on the go.

Roguelike Depth — Every run brings new choices. Every death is a step toward something stronger.

Mythic World of "Classic of Mountains and Seas" — Navigate ancient lands steeped in lore, from storm-lashed mountains to celestial islands hidden beyond the sky.

- Exciting Dinosaur Matchups: Who will win the fight, a T-REX with a BROADSWORD or a PTERODACTYL with a KATANA? Find out as you choose from an ample roster of prehistoric combatants, including species like Spinosaurus, Brontosaurus, Stegosaurus, Triceratops and many more! Each class of dinosaur has their own fighting style, featuring strengths and weaknesses in relation to other classes!

- A DEADLY era: Engage in deadly prehistoric battles, augmented with modern weaponry. Maneuver pitfalls and environmental hazards. Avoid ambush predators that lunge from water and or just run around and bully the weaker dinosaurs!

- Fast-Pace combat - FIGHT LIKE A BEAST!: Use high flying moves and quick movements gain the advantage, dodge, block, attack from the air, fire projectiles and make use of species-specific super moves and abilities. Balance use of the "Special" meter to supercharge attacks at just the right moment. Time your dodges and strike your opponent at the PERFECT time!

- A Brutal Assault: Don't just defeat your enemies, punish them with unrelenting fury, spraying blood and gore across the battlefield. Shred your enemy limb from limb with devastating finisher moves that insult your foe for the final time! Remember to EAT YOUR ENEMIES for extra HEALTH!

- Adventure Mode: Follow the story of 6 dinosaurs, each with their own adventure to complete. Some will go from hatchling to LEGEND, while other will pursue strange creatures not from this realm...

- DinoCHESS Mode: Ever play "Mortal Kombat Chess"? No? Well then this will all be brand new for you! This mode follows the basic structure of chess; players move 5 piece types ( pawn, rook, bishop, knight, queen and king ) around a chessboard in an effort to capture their opponent's king. However, in THIS version of chess, 2 pieces that occupy the same space must BATTLE IT OUT in 1-on-1 DINOSAUR COMBAT! The victor gets the disputed space, and the loser goes EXTINCT!

Apprentice to Archmage. Beat the clock, or climb through the rubble.




At level 5 the apprentice picks an element, and a pillar of light drops from the sky onto that spot.

AWAKEN AT LEVEL 5

You start as an apprentice with plain arcane bolts. At level 5 you pick one of nine elements: fire, ice, storm, tide, stone, poison, light, shadow or death. From then on its spells show up in your level-ups, you get its signature weapon, and your ultimate becomes the school's own. Go deep enough and the school splits in two: at your second class change you pick a branch, and it changes your look and your ultimate.

THE TOWER IS COLLAPSING

Every regular floor has an epic monster and a timer. If the timer hits zero, the arena's rim cracks crimson and the ceiling starts coming down on you mid-fight. The epic can still be killed; you just have to do it under falling stone.

Stay out of the light too long and the dark seals your spells. Step back into the light to break the seal.

NEVER BETRAYED BY RNG

Don't like the draw? Reroll. Never want to see that card again? Banish it and it's gone for the rest of the run. Every run starts with three rerolls and two banishes.

THREE DOORS AFTER EVERY FLOOR

Each door changes the next floor. More enemies, faster ones, tougher ones, or fewer but deadlier, and a bigger payout in gold, soulstones or XP for the trouble. At most once per zone, a door offers a breather instead: fewer, softer foes, smaller rewards, and a healing rune always waiting. Sometimes (never more than once per zone) a door opens on a treasure room: over a hundred pots and a twenty-second fuse.



There are chests hidden around the tower. Some of them have teeth.

THE VILLAGE BELOW THE TOWER

Every climb ends back on the ground, in a village that grows between runs. Raise its buildings, take contracts and bounties at the Adventurers' Guild, craft set gear at the Workshop, and break your gear's limits with ore from the mines of Studund. A Limit Break never fails, so there is no gambling on upgrades.

Beyond the village there is land to take back. Cut timber in the Blackwood and stone in the Abandoned Quarry, cook meals to carry into the tower, and light the road to the Abandoned Wasteland. Destroy its nests, then clear, till and plant the ground you reclaim. People you free from their prisons are treated at the Infirmary and settle in homes you build outside the village.

THE ROAD TO THE SUMMIT

Diofru launches in Early Access and grows upward from there.
  • Early Access: floors 1 to 50 across fifteen zones, with a boss on every tenth floor. From there the tower keeps growing, zone by zone, and the schools keep getting deeper. We are not putting a floor count or a date on what comes next, and we would rather say that plainly than promise something we have to take back.
  • 1.0: the finished climb, all the way to the summit.

UNDER THE HOOD

  • 50 floors in 15 zones. Past floor 20 the tower turns to fire and lava, then water and ice, then root and forest, and every ten floors bring their own monsters, epic monsters, boss and gear sets.
  • 4 weapon slots + a transformation-only signature slot + 6 passive slots. Two active spells equipped at a time.
  • 32 weapons with 59 evolved forms, 33 passives, 51 active spells, 25 relics, all gated by the element you awakened into.
  • Elemental weapons evolve into one of two forms you choose. They differ in how they fight, not in strength.
  • Evolution is your call: raise a weapon with its paired passive, beat an epic or a boss, and open the Evolution Chest it drops. Missed it? The forge can evolve it too.
  • Three doors between every floor. The one you pick sets the next floor's danger and reward.
  • Light and dark are resources. Stand in the dark too long and your magic gets sealed.
  • Finish a zone and the next zone's first floor becomes a checkpoint. You start fresh there; your strength comes from the village.
  • Die and the run ends. Soulstones, materials, gear and everything you built in the village stay.

You decide who gets electricity — and who doesn’t.

Directive 220 is a dark, atmospheric management game where you take the role of an energy dispatcher in a collapsing authoritarian regime. Every decision carries a cost. Hospitals, factories, the military, and civilians all demand power — but you will never have enough to satisfy everyone.

For fans of Papers, Please and political management games.

⚡ WHAT YOU DO

Each work shift, you must:

• Allocate limited power across competing sectors
• Respond to urgent incidents and incoming calls
• Balance grid stability, government pressure, and citizen survival
• Make irreversible decisions under constant time pressure

Every choice solves one problem — and creates another.

⚖️ IMPOSSIBLE DECISIONS

Prioritize critical infrastructure or follow political orders.
Keep the system stable — or protect the people.

You cannot save everyone.

📉 A SYSTEM UNDER PRESSURE

Balance three key forces:

• Grid stability
• Government trust
• Citizen satisfaction

Push too far in any direction, and the system begins to crack.

🔥 FEATURES

• Real-time decision-making under pressure
• Dynamic events and reactive phone calls
• Multiple outcomes based on your choices
• Retro-inspired UI and dystopian atmosphere
• Narrative-driven progression with daily consequences

🧠 CONSEQUENCES MATTER

Mistakes are remembered.
Patterns are noticed.

As pressure builds, your role becomes more dangerous — and more political.

How long can you keep the lights on?

Loot. Survive. Extract. Everything you carry out is yours to keep, and everything you don't is gone.

The Direlands shattered long ago, and their lost zones drift beyond reach. Mages have found a way back in through rifts. Step through, fight past whatever waits on the other side, and make it home with what you came for.

FEATURES

  • Cast everything. Build your spellbook from the scrolls you find, from fire and frost to lightning and acid, and unleash a devastating ultimate when the fight turns.

  • Run it your way. Explore a cursed vale, a walled city of the dead, a golem stronghold above the clouds and a wild island. Complete objectives, hunt bosses, and find the way out.

  • Keep what you earn. Bank your haul between runs, forge better gear, and grow stronger in Strength, Agility and Magic.

  • Better together. Team up with friends, or enter contested zones where rival parties fight over the same loot.

  • Play your way. Mouse and keyboard or a controller, with full controller support.

A love letter to the open-world fantasy RPGs of the early online days, built for today's extraction fans.

The whole war, forty muddy yards at a time.

Dirt & Viscera is a real-time roguelike about the worst job on the Western Front: holding a trench, and then leaving it. You don't command a tidy army — you command whatever the cards deal you, whatever you can afford this second, and whatever's still breathing after the last barrage.

Two economies, one terrible decision.

Cards decide what you can field. Requisition decides whether you can afford it right now. Riflemen, machine guns, snipers, flamethrowers, trench raiders, Mark IV tanks, gas, walking barrages, a biplane strafing run — you draw them, you pay for them, you place them in the mud.

Then you choose when to go over the top.

Holding is safe. Holding loses. Sooner or later you blow the whistle and send your men across — into wire, into machine guns, into artillery zeroed on the open ground. Push too early and they're scythed down; push too late and the trench is overrun. The whole game lives in that one decision.

A front that fights back, and remembers.

Barbed wire snags both sides. Tanks grind green fields into the iconic cratered mud. Flamethrowers and shells reduce woods to splintered stumps. The dead stay where they fall — and the next barrage mangles the corpses all over again.

Build a run worth dying for.

A branching, FTL-style campaign across four sectors: pick your route, see the upgrade each position rewards, and snowball a force from ~70 upgrades — half earned through your own deeds. Choose one of eight commanders, lock in a doctrine, set your difficulty, and stack optional hardship mutators for more glory and more pain. It ends where it should: a super-heavy land cruiser, rolling for your trench.



And when the campaign's done — Endless.

Hold against a horde that never stops growing. Take a trench and the front lurches forward onto fresh ground; lose one and you fall back to the reserve line. Draft an upgrade every trench you capture. Suspend and resume any run. Chase your best.

Grim, and quietly hilarious.

"Sarge says morale is high. Sarge is lying." The horror is real — but so is the gallows humour. This is the war as told by the men at the bottom of the ditch.

No microtransactions. No licensed anything. Just dirt, viscera, and the next whistle.

Welcome to the show where everything goes wrong.

You're a contestant on a chaotic game show, and the course ahead is a gauntlet of disasters — a flat tire, a ninja attack, a goose with a grudge, the plane going down. Every one of them stands between you and the finish line.

You clear them by playing combos of tool cards — a pool noodle, a car battery, a bucket of fried chicken, whatever's in your hand — and pulling off a gloriously stupid plan with them. Build your deck, weigh your odds, ride your luck, and race to the finish. Clear a disaster and roll to advance; wipe out and you're stuck, but you draw a fresh tool for next time.

Only one of you needs to own it

Six players on one couch, or online with Steam Remote Play Together — one copy seats the whole table. Family Sharing works too.

Two games in one

With a crowd — the party game. 2+ players, online or local. You pitch your absurd plan out loud (or type it), and everyone bets karma on whether you'll actually pull it off — backing you boosts your odds, doubting you is just a wager. It's loud, it's social, and the table is the judge. Friends without the game join from a phone as a bet-pad, or watch the live couch-feed.

On your own — the strategy deckbuilder. Solo and 1v1 strip away the table and sharpen into a tight roguelite: read the odds, build your deck, manage your karma, and outrace the field. Solo sends you up a full ladder of rival bots; 1v1 Duels are a head-to-head battle of nerve and deck. Quieter, headsier — all the tactics, none of the table noise.

Features

  • A deckbuilder's tool economy welded to a betting table — a prediction market in karma where the only lever on your odds is positive (no griefing, ever).
  • A roster of quirky contestants, each with a signature move, plus unlockable skins.
  • A bombastic MC calling the chaos — and a collectible comic "Funny Pages" gallery you unlock as you play.
  • Earn FAME between runs to unlock characters, skins, and tougher difficulty tiers.
  • Dozens of absurd disasters across three flavors — mundane, absurd, and dire-played-for-laughs.
  • Full controller support and a Steam Deck–friendly layout. Solo & local play work fully offline, no account needed.

Buy once. Play forever.

No pay-to-win, no predatory nonsense — just optional expansion packs and cosmetics down the road if you want them.

about_html:
Mimetic Perception Syndrome has been declared a national health emergency, and no one can say where it comes from.
Those who contract it see and hear things that no one else can perceive.

In its late stages, MPS no longer stops at perception.
It begins to imitate the patient, from the way they move to the things they remember, right down to the sound of their voice.

When you come to at Pescadero Medical Center, the last transport is long gone and the ward is dead silent.
Ten floors, two elevators, and nothing you see can be relied on.

• A Game That Adapts to You
Difficulty, pacing, and tension respond to how you play, and seeing through the hospital does not mean you are any match for it.

• No Two Runs Are Alike
Anomalies, their variants, and even the floors where nothing is wrong are reshuffled with every run.
Memorizing the ward will not save you, and neither will a guide.

• Your Eyes Are Not Enough
What you hear matters just as much as what you see, and sometimes it is the silence that gives a floor away.

• Your Voice Can Come Back
With the microphone feature, your own voice becomes part of the horror, though not necessarily the way you remember it.

• Your Twitch Chat Plays Along
With Twitch integration, your viewers bet on every decision you make, and some of them end up in the hospital themselves.

• Play Your Way
Play with mouse and keyboard or with a controller.
A headset is strongly recommended.

Not every anomaly jumps out at you.

Some do exactly that, while others change the familiar just enough to make you start doubting yourself.
Maybe it is a sound from an empty room, a movement at the edge of your vision, or a voice that sounds strikingly like your own.

Maybe it is gone the moment you look again, and maybe it was never there.
Or maybe it has known for quite a while now that you noticed it.

Do not trust what you see.

Sit down, put your headphones on, and let a submarine keep you company while you focus.

Dive Log: A Focus Voyage is an idle treasure-hunting game built around a focus timer. Pick the timing mode that suits you, hit Set Sail, then get on with the work in front of you.

Your submarine dives while you focus, and comes back from every session with a hold full of treasure.

Pick your timer

Four timing modes: Focus Sessions (the classic pomodoro cycle), Deep Focus, Stopwatch and Custom Time. Focus and break lengths are yours to set, so each run fits the state you're in.

Tools for the working day

A to-do list, quick notes, a voyage diary and an alarm are all built in. Keep track of what you're working on, catch an idea the moment it lands, and write down how the day went to read back later. Your submarine's own progress is recorded alongside it.

Focus and grow

While you focus, your submarine trawls the depths and hauls in treasures and materials. Once a voyage ends, spend what it brought back on upgrades and new seas, and fill your codex with over two hundred treasures.

Make the sea your own

Music and ambience (rain, sea, campfire and more white-noise-style sounds) are included, and you can load in your own audio files. Even the alarm sound can be swapped out.

The treasures in the sea can be your own work too. The built-in treasure editor takes you from uploading an image to a finished piece without leaving the game or touching a single file, and you can publish straight to the Steam Workshop. Subscribe to what other captains have made and their treasures join your sea.

KEY FEATURES

・Four timing modes: Focus Sessions, Deep Focus (focus blocks run back to back, breaks saved for the end), Stopwatch and Custom Time, plus plenty of options for tuning the cycle.

・While you focus on real work, your submarine explores the seafloor and picks up treasures and materials along the way.

・Spend what your submarine brings back on part upgrades and fresh paint, and open up five seas, each with its own story and treasures.

・Collect over two hundred treasures and fill up the codex. Every sea hides a relic of its own!

・49 achievements covering focus hours, submarine progress and collecting. The counters keep climbing after you unlock them, so the work you put in still gets recorded.

・Open the diary any time to see each day's focus time and submarine progress, with weekly and monthly totals put together for you.

・The sky and the weather follow the real time of day, or you can pin the light to morning, noon, dusk or night.

・Custom audio files: music, ambience and the alarm sound can all be swapped for your own.

・Treasure editor: upload an image, write the description, and design a treasure of your own inside the game. No coding required.

・Steam Workshop: publish your treasure packs without leaving the game, and subscribe to what other players have made.

・Mini Mode: shrink the window into a corner of your desktop and keep the timer, your to-do list and your submarine in view.

・Steam Cloud saves supported.

In everyday life, finishing something rarely gives much back right away.

That's the gap Dive Log fills: the time you spend concentrating turns into a voyage and a hold full of treasure.

Step into the war-torn world of Sengoku-era Japan, where rival clans clash for dominance and the title of Shogun hangs in the balance. As the leader of your clan, you must navigate a landscape of shifting alliances, brutal warfare, and political intrigue. Expand your domain through clever diplomacy, masterful strategy, and decisive battles.

  • Strategic Leadership: Manage resources, develop your territory, and command great armies against your foes.

  • Cunning Diplomacy: Form alliances, negotiate trade, and manipulate the political landscape to your advantage.

  • Tactical Warfare: Engage in real-time battles where terrain, weather, and army composition affect the outcome.

  • Grand Selection: Choose from a wide array of historical clans, all with their own traits and ambitions.

  • Dynamic Campaigns: No two playthroughs are the same - adapt to shifting threats and changing conditions.

Whether you rule with honor, deception, or sheer force, the fate of Japan rests in your hands. Will you rise above the ashes of war and claim the title of Shogun - or be forgotten in the tides of history?

Divided Empire: SENGOKU is set to release in 2026. Add it to your wishlist today and be notified when it releases.

Also consider following the game to get development updates and more.

"PROTECTING YOUR OSHI." That is your purpose. Your Why.

Discover the behind the scenes of streamers in a document inspection adventure game, taking place in an increasingly popular VTuber firm "STELLARIA." 

You are a newly assigned security guard for this firm.
However, the true reason you chose this job was far from "sense of justice" or "stable income."

You have been rooting for this firm's affiliated VTuber "Hoshina Luna" since her debut.
From today, you are no longer just watching over her, you are right there to protect her, from a distance closer than anyone else.

INSPECT DOCUMENTS, DETECT DISCREPANCIES

Approaching the gate are authorized personnel, streaming staffs, VTubers, and many other unrecognized visitors.

Entry pass's expiry date, today's visitor schedule, affiliation cert, permit card――
Make sure there is no contradictions among the many documents laid all over your desk.

There will be more and more to look out for as the days go by:
- Comparing entry pass to schedule
- Anti-forgery hologram verification
- X-ray of belongings
- Emergency plan for intruders' forced attempts to break through
- Voice authentication

If you see anything suspicious, you can also interrogate the visitors.
Whether to believe their words, or their documents――
The final decision is up to you.

「IDEAL」 vs 「REALITY」――DISCOVERING THE OTHER SIDE

A security guard mechanically inspecting anonymized individuals by day.
A crazed hardcore fan spamming red star chats on his phone at night.

The sweet smile they show on their streams, their indifferent gaze at the entrance.
As you continue to impersonally inspect documents, you caught a glimpse of something weren't meant to.
A discrepancy, not in the documents, but between your ideals and reality.

YOUR JUDGEMENT AFFECTS HOW THE STORY UNFOLDS

You came to this job to protect your dear Oshi.
However, contradicting to the public appearance, an ominous vibe lingers within the firm, 

If you abide by the rules of such firm, will you really be able to protect your Oshi?
Or, will you break rules to defend her?

Your judgement and obsession will decide the outcome of this journey.

THROW. DODGE. DOMINATE.

Dodgeball Bash turns a simple sport into a fast, skill-based battle for control of the court.

Read your opponent, create openings, and react at the right moment. Launch precise throws, escape pressure with well-timed dodges, shut down attacks with blocks, or reverse the momentum of a match with a perfect catch.

The fundamentals are easy to understand—but mastering every mechanic, decision, and mind game takes practice.

SOLO AND ONLINE COMPETITION

Sharpen your skills through solo content or step onto the court against other players online.

Every match is built around timing, positioning, and reading your opponent. Winning is not just about throwing first—it is about knowing when to attack, when to defend, and when to take a risk.

GAME MODES

The upcoming demo features three distinct ways to play:

OFFICIAL 1V1

A direct competitive match where timing, precision, and smart decisions determine the winner.

LADDER

Play through a structured series of matches and prove how far you can climb.

KING OF THE COURT

Defend your position, build a winning streak, and remain in control as new challengers rotate in. The full game is planned to support online King of the Court matches for up to six players.

These modes represent the initial demo selection—not the final scope of Dodgeball Bash. Additional modes and features are planned as development continues.

TRAINING ACADEMY

Learn the fundamentals or sharpen your reactions through focused training exercises.

Practice the four core mechanics—throw, dodge, block, and catch—and prepare yourself for more demanding matches.

DAILY AND WEEKLY MISSIONS

Take on rotating daily and weekly objectives that encourage different approaches and provide new goals to pursue.

Whether you are training, competing, or experimenting with different strategies, there is always another challenge waiting.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYER

A cozy and gentle Reversi game with Japanese-style characters.

Set deep in rural Japan, Reversi in the Countryside is a board game where you can enjoy Reversi matches and conversations with characters in a Japanese-style countryside mansion.

In Free Match, you can casually play against CPUs of various strength levels. Since each match is easy to finish in a short amount of time, it is suitable both for quick play sessions and for times when you want to think carefully.

In Story Mode, you visit a countryside mansion where your relatives live, and the story progresses through conversations and Reversi matches with the characters.

In Tutorial Mode, you can gradually learn the basic rules of Reversi, as well as concepts such as corners, edges, inside moves, and endgame thinking while looking at the board. The lessons are explained in a conversation format so that beginners can follow along easily.

In Puzzle Mode, you search for a good move from a given position.

In Endgame Puzzle Mode, you can try problems where you think about which move to choose in the endgame.

Main features:

- Free Match

- Story Mode

- Tutorial Mode

- Puzzle Mode

- Endgame Puzzle Mode

- In-match conversations with characters

- Match results and review elements
